L23: This is an upgrade of EGNS Ronaldsway Airport on the Isle of Man.
L24: If you haven't been here you jolly well should. Three things I very much enjoy are road racing, rallying and cutting that pesky tax bill. This place has all three in spades.
L25: This wasn't tooo bad compared to other stock airports but I still felt like interfering with it. It was a wrench killing off the magnificant golden structure to the right of the terminal that looked like something Prince would've lived in, or emerged from on stage, but progress demanded it.
L26: All the ground textures and paint have been binned and replaced. The correct taxi system with taxiways and parking spaces has been installed. Light has been smeared all over. Outlying areas such as car parks, the fire station section and weird stretches of waste ground have been filled out. The airport approach has had some rock embedded in it.
L27: A particular highlight is the custom terminal designed by Ted Andrews. You may thank Skell300  cite26†https://flightsim.to/profile/skell300 for finding it, refining it and doing the textures to work in this. It definitely ties it up very nicely. Hopefully more custom buildings will pop along.
L28: One thing I couldn't solve is this area's fondness for turning luminous green. It's been like that for a long time so go hassle Asobo rather than me.
L29: V 1.4
L30: Adds the Jet Centre as a startable hangar.
L31: 
L32: Adds some optional items from this cite27†https://flightsim.to/file/23692/superspud-airport-asset-library L33: 
L34: Clears up a few mistakes such as missing hold short lines and a car that has been sitting on the apron like a lonely turd at sunset for months. Whoops.
L35: 
L36: Sorts out some night lighting and cloudy glass.

L25: 
L26: Welcome!
L27: 
L28: Thank you for checking out our scenery, many hours have been put into this project to hopefully be an accurate rendition of Riyadh's King Khaled Airport (Updated to match 2023 changes!)
L29: 
L30: King Khalid International Airport was opened in 1983 in Riyadh city. It is located in an area of 375 km2 about 35 km from the city center, consisting of five passengers’ terminals, which together serve more than 28.5​ million passengers a year.
L31: There are still many aspects that are still in WIP, and will continue on building on them as I am able to, but will keep sharing the latest layout for those who are using the latest charts and/or Vatsim, so be sure to check the changelog whenever an update is available!
L32: 
L33: This scenery DOES NOT contain static aircraft at gates, the ones you see in the screenshots are AI aircraft

L23: Presenting my next detailed scenery for india. This time we are visiting one of the major cities in southern india chennai.
L24: The aviation history of the city began in 1910, when a city-based Corsican hotelier Giacomo D'Angelis built an aircraft and tested it.Madras Airport was one of the first airports of India, commissioned in 1948.Although the first aircraft "de Havilland" landed in Madras Airport in 1932, the usage was confined only to military operations during World War II In 1952, the Civil Aviation Department took over its operations followed by the AAI in 1972.
L25:  It is located in Tirusulam, 21 km (13 mi) from the city centre. Chennai International Airport is the fourth busiest airport in India behind New Delhi, Mumbai and Bangalore and third busiest in international traffic and cargo capacity in the country behind New Delhi and Mumbai. It is also 49th busiest airport in Asia making it one of the four major airports in India under the top 50 list. In financial year 2020, the airport handled 22.27 million passengers.
L26: Features:
L27: 
L28:   * Highly detailed domestic and international terminals with interior modelling.
L29:   * Highly detailed airport entrance and apron area.
L30:   * Detailed optimized HD Textures.
L31:   * Realistic night lighting with custom light glow for taxi signs.
L32:   * Realistic grass coverage for the entire airport.
L33:   * Custom modelled runway bridge for runway 12-30 crossing the adayar river.
L34: 
L35: Installation:
L36: 
L37: Just drag and drop the vomm-vomm folder into your community folder.
L38: 
L39: Known Issues:
L40: Below are few known issues exists in the scenery that is mostly limited to the simulation.
L41:   * Terminal building may flicker when viewed at a distance.
L42:   * Transparent glass on the terminal may flicker when viewed very close.
L43:   * The runway bridge on the runway 12-30 appears floating above the water, this is because of the terrain limitation in the sim, which is not placing the object on the ground when it is below the ground level.
L44:   * Taxilight/Runway light over the bridge will illuminate the aircraft cockpit.
L45:

L48:   * Added ceiling light objects inside the terminal for more realistic look from apron during night time.

L37:     * Airport fire station
L38:     * Operation building with ATC tower
L39:     * Biman Bangladesh hangar

L41:     * Main cargo terminals (Biman Cargo Complex and Biman Cargo Village)
L42:   * Additional details for airport garden and car parkings
L43:   * A precisely placed runway, with calibrated ILS localizers
L44:   * Remade taxiway system, with corrected taxiway names as documented (however there are some new taxiways not mentioned in official airport diagram)
L45:   * Taxiway signs
L46:   * Handcrafted paint elements, including custom taxiway edges, hatched areas and parking bay number markings
L47:   * Remade parking bays, with correct bay numbers as documented

L23: ### Important advise for MSFS2020 users! Photogrammetry
L24: There are two versions available for MSFS2020, the photogrammetry OFF file is the version NOT COMPATIBLE with photogrammetry, for those who fly with the WU19: Brazil photogrammetry disabled or not installed. L25: Brasília International Airport – Presidente Juscelino Kubitschek (IATA: BSB, ICAO: SBBR) is an international airport in the administrative region of Lago Sul, in the Federal District. It is the third largest airport in Brazil in terms of number of passengers transported and the first airport in South America to implement independent simultaneous parallel operations.
L26: This is a scenery using the 3D models made by master Zanolli (Thank you for your willingness to provide the models for this project) for FSX and P3D, with only minor changes on my part. They represent the airport at the time they were created in 2015, so several aspects do not represent the real airport today. There is no forecast for updating the models.

L23: 
L24: Airport description
L25: 
L26: Krakow-Balice John Paul II International Airport is an international airport located near Kraków, 11km west of the city centre, in southern Poland. It is the second-busiest airport of the country in terms of the volume of passengers served annually.
L27: 
L28: The scenery is designed with an apron layout available IRL since July 2024 for VATSIM usage.
L29: 
L30: 
L31: Features
L32:   * updated apron layout (July 2024)
L33:   * construction site of new cargo terminal
L34:   * custom buildings: Terminal, Tower, HEMS, Administrative-Technical Building, ST10Bis transformer station, New Cargo building (on construction site), firefighters station, weather radar building (on the northern hill), Camaldolese Monastery (on the southeastern hill)
L35:   * detailed ground markings (VATSIM compatible)
L36:   * custom static airplane on military apron: M-28 Bryza (Skytruck), C-295 Casa, Ukrainian government A319
L37:   * default Asobo jetways or GSX jetways - you need to select your version during installation
L38: 
L39: 
L40: Optional dependencies for 3D models:
L41: 
L42:   * Mikea.at - AssetPack by Mikea.at for HEMS helicopter (optional, but recommended)
L43:   * Windy Things for wind sock on HEMS and flags near main terminal (optional, but recommended)
L44:   * Animated Human 3D Models Library (optional, but recommended)
L45:   * airport military (old) tower requires default KMKX scenery installed (optional)
L46:   * FSLTL for static aircraft on civil apron (optional, disabled by default)
L47:

L50: Optional static aircraft
L51: As default static civil aircraft are disabled. You can enable some static LOT, RYR, WZZ aircraft on stands 7R (7 ia also unavailable), 13, 19 and 28. To enable them after upacking the add-on find in folder "Scenery\airport-epkk-krakow\papadelta-epkk-static-civil-aircrafts-fsltl" a file named "static-civil-aircrafts-fsltl.bgl.disabled" and rename it to "static-civil-aircrafts-fsltl.bgl" (without ".disabled"). FSLTL is required for 3D models.
L52: As default static military aircraft are enabled. To disable them find in folder "Scenery\airport-epkk-krakow\papadelta-epkk-static-military-aircrafts" file named "static-military-aircrafts.bgl" and change it name to "static-military-aircrafts.bgl.disabled" (with ".disabled").
L53: As default static Ukrainian government A319 is enabled. To disable it find in folder "Scenery\airport-epkk-krakow\papadelta-epkk-static-A319-URABA" file named "nereusz-epkk-static-A319-URABA.bgl" and change it name to "nereusz-epkk-static-A319-URABA.bgl.disabled" (with ".disabled").
L54: IRL HEMS airbase in Krakow has been moved to Kokotów. If you feel that standing HEMS helicopter is not needed for you it can be disabled. To disable it find in folder "Scenery\airport-epkk-krakow\papadelta-epkk-static-hems-helicopter" file named "nereusz-epkk-static-hems-helicopter.bgl" and change it name to "nereusz-epkk-static-hems-helicopter.bgl.disabled" (with ".disabled").

L58: How to install?
L59: 
L60: In the ZIP file you have 3 folders (and readme.txt):
L61:   *     * \GSX-Profile-EPKK\
L62:     * \papadelta-epkk-DEFAULT-jetways\
L63:     * \papadelta-epkk-GSX-jetways\
L64:     * \epkk-readme.txt
L65: 
L66: It's required that you always have only one version installed at a time. If you install both, weird things can happen (visual glitches etc).
L67: 
L68: If you don't know what to install, please install default version in "papadelta-epkk-DEFAULT-jetways" directory as it's safer option and will work for everyone.
L69: Please don’t overwrite old airport with new one as some internal structure may change. Always remove old version of the airport and then install new one.
L70: 
L71: 
L72: 
L73: Steps if you don’t have GSX PRO
L74: 
L75: If you don't have installed GSX Pro, you have to install "papadelta-epkk-DEFAULT-jetways" version. It uses default ASOBO jetways and works with no additional requirements. Copy this and only this folder to your community.
L76: 
L77: Steps if you do have GSX PRO installed
L78: But if you do have GSX PRO (and only then), you should use "papadelta-epkk-GSX-jetways" version. It contains prettier glass jetways from GSX package.
L79: 
L80: Also GSX requires it’s profile to be installed (it won’t recognize it just by installing airport). Two GSX Profile files (.ini and .py) are in \GSX-Profile-EPKK\ folder. You need to find them and place BOTH the .ini and .py files in %appdata%\Roaming\Virtuali\GSX\MSFS
L81: 
L82:

L84: GSX Pro profile
L85: GSX Pro profile is included in this add-on, but GSX requires it to be installed (it won’t recognize it just by installing airport). Two GSX Profile files (.ini and .py) are in \nereusz-airport-epkk-krakow\@GSX-Profile\ folder. You need to find them and place BOTH the .ini and .py files in %appdata%\Roaming\Virtuali\GSX\MSFS

L105: FAQ
L106:   * Can I use this addon with Drzewiecki Design buildings?
L107: No, you can not. If you try, I'm pretty sure you will end up with DD buildings on the new taxiway G. Some buildings in DD scenery are grouped as one object and can't be included one by one even if you try.
L108:   * Is there a GSX profile for this airport?
L109: Yes. See the above GSX Pro profile section.
L110:   * Is it compatible with MSFS2024?
L111: Kind of. Trees from apron have been removed. But MSFS2024 uses differently positioned ground textures that can be visible as not aligned with ground of the airport. We'll work on it. But if you just want to fly and use apron on VATSIM you can do it easily. But for now main compatibility is provided only for MSFS 2020, and 2024 is considered as "usable".
